subject: Orchestrating APAC SI demo queue + AWS marketplace preflight
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Saket Rao <saket@fuseworks.com>
Cc: Amy Liu <amy.liu@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Orchestrating APAC SI demo queue + AWS marketplace preflight

Hi Saket,

Thanks for agreeing to co-host the APAC joint demo. To make the most of the session for the two prospects we discussed, I propose we run two consecutive, tightly scoped demos on the same day so engineering and the SI can hand off smoothly: a 90-min "technical deep" followed by a 45-min "purchase & marketplace" walkthrough.

Proposed window (APAC-friendly):
- Option A: Thu, 8 Jun — 09:00–11:15 JST (two back-to-back slots)
- Option B: Fri, 9 Jun — 13:00–15:15 SGT

If you and Akira can confirm which day works and who will present the SI integration piece, we can lock calendar hosts. I looped in Amy from AWS to confirm marketplace listing preflight coverage (private listing checks, entitlements, and billing flow).

Attached is a first-draft runbook with suggested attendee lists and cut points (apac-demo-runbook_v1.pdf). Also attached a short checklist for the marketplace items we want AWS to confirm ahead of time (aws-marketplace-checklist.xlsx).

Key asks:
- Saket/Akira: confirm preferred day and who will present the SI segment
- Amy: can AWS join the second block and run the marketplace checklist with us?
- Kimberly/Marissa (cc): confirm host coverage & recording settings for Redwood side

Thanks — I can be flexible for mornings PT to work through logistics.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Partner Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: apac-demo-runbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), aws-marketplace-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

From: Saket Rao <saket@fuseworks.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Akira Sato <akira.sato@si-partner.jp>, Amy Liu <amy.liu@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 21:40:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Orchestrating APAC SI demo queue + AWS marketplace preflight

Ben — thanks for the clear plan. Akira and I reviewed; June 8th works better than the 9th because we have a product launch blackout on the 9th in APAC for one of our customers.

We can do the two-slot model but prefer splitting as: 08 Jun 09:00–10:30 JST (technical integration + Q&A) and 08 Jun 12:00–13:00 JST (marketplace & procurement walk). The hour gap gives us time for a quick internal debrief and to bring in the right AWS specialist.

Akira will lead the first slot (integration, architecture, run-of-show) and I will handle the prod/ops handoff and the appendix on deployment templates. Akira asked if you can confirm whether Redwood will record the technical slot and provide a short clips pack afterward — our legal team needs that recorded segments are stored for 90 days only.

I attached a short customer brief we will reference (customer-brief.pdf).

Saket
Solution Director, FuseWorks

Attachments: customer-brief.pdf (PDF, 480KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Saket Rao <saket@fuseworks.com>, Akira Sato <akira.sato@si-partner.jp>, Amy Liu <amy.liu@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Orchestrating APAC SI demo queue + AWS marketplace preflight

Forwarding Saket's confirmation — they prefer Jun 8 with a short buffer between the deep-dive and the marketplace hour.

Kimberly / Marissa — could you please confirm:
- Redwood host(s) for 09:00–10:30 JST and 12:00–13:00 JST (we need one tech host + one business host)
- Recording policy: Saket says FuseWorks OK with 90-day retention; is 90 days OK for Redwood recordings? If not, propose an alternative
- Can we get an Ops contact to run through the AWS marketplace checklist with Amy during the second slot?

If we can triage host coverage today I will send a calendar invite to everyone and attach the runbook.

Thanks — Ben

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Saket Rao <saket@fuseworks.com>, Amy Liu <amy.liu@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orchestrating APAC SI demo queue + AWS marketplace preflight

Ben — quick notes from my side:
- I can host the business/marketplace hour (12:00–13:00 JST). Marissa can cover the tech host if she is available for the 09:00–10:30 slot. Marissa — are you available?
- Recording: 90-day retention is fine. We will mark the recording as internal+customer and restrict download to presenters only. Legal has okayed that for partner co-demos with a signed consent line in the runbook.
- Ops/Marketplace: I will ask our Partnerships ops lead (Irena on the ops side) to join Amy for a 15-min preflight call on Jun 6. I attached a tentative availability grid (availability-grid.ics) — please pick preferred times.

If Marissa confirms the tech slot we can lock the invites.

Kimberly
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: availability-grid.ics (ICS)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Saket Rao <saket@fuseworks.com>, Amy Liu <amy.liu@amazon.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Jun 8 APAC co-sell demo (tech + marketplace) — invites sent

All — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming the schedule and hosts:

Final schedule (all times JST):
- 08 Jun 09:00–10:30 JST — Technical integration + live Q&A
  Hosts: Marissa Cole (Redwood) + Akira Sato (FuseWorks)
- 08 Jun 12:00–13:00 JST — Marketplace & procurement walkthrough
  Hosts: Kimberly Park (Redwood), Saket Rao (FuseWorks), Amy Liu (AWS Marketplace)

Notes/asks:
- Recording retention set to 90 days (Kimberly confirmed). We will place recording in restricted Drive folder and share clip access to presenters only.
- Ops preflight scheduled: 06 Jun 09:00–09:30 JST (Amy + Irena + Ben) — calendar invite sent. Please review aws-marketplace-checklist.xlsx ahead of that call.
- Runbook and customer brief links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_marketplace-preflight (apac-demo-runbook_v1.pdf; customer-brief.pdf)
- Action: Ben — please route the final attendee list and HubSpot meeting link so we can attach to the invite.

I attached the final runbook and the marketplace checklist to the invite. Looking forward to a smooth handoff.

Marissa Cole
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference

Attachments: apac-demo-runbook_v1.pdf, aws-marketplace-checklist.xlsx
